verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim streaming SSR and progressive hydration to reach interactivity quickly (solid-gh-4, solid-gh-12), and SSR/isomorphic rendering is documented (solid-gh-14). However, there is no independent/hands-on evidence specifically confirming progressive hydration behavior, and community comments raise general SSR/SolidStart reliability concerns (e.g. slow routing, lacking docs) that aren't a direct contradiction but add uncertainty. Missing for 10: independent verification of progressive hydration in practice, benchmarks/case studies specific to hydration speed, and detail on how progressive hydration is configured/used.
